email.account_security.new-sign-in.text:
Your {{appName}} account was just signed in to with {{strategy}}, from a browser you have not used before.

If this was not you, open your account, revoke the sessions you do not recognize and delete any passkey or authenticator that is not yours. Revoked sessions stay listed there for 30 days. Also secure the email inbox and the Google, Microsoft or GitHub account you sign in with.
